payload.title: Filtering and Detrending with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library for filtering and detrending paleoclimate data. It covers various signal processing techniques applied to benthic foraminifera δ18O data from the LR04 benthic stack.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and load the LR04 dataset using Pyleoclim.
steps.title: Preamble and Data Loading

steps.description: Apply empirical mode decomposition (EMD) to detrend the data and visualize the results.
steps.title: Detrending with Empirical Mode Decomposition

steps.description: Apply Lanczos and Butterworth filters to the data and visualize the filtered results.
steps.title: Filtering with Lanczos and Butterworth
